thread:
morgan: Quick follow-up from the all-hands Q&A: can we get a crisp summary of the new release playbook and who gets pinged during canaries?
chet: TL;DR: minor releases move to a 3-week rhythm, majors monthly. The playbook covers flags, canary sizes, notif windows, rollback triggers, and post-release notes.
riley: Who is the canonical owner of the release playbook? where should teams link their tickets?
cto-aaron: SRE maintains the playbook; eng leads own per-release rollout plans and must link the release ticket to the playbook section. Use `#release-playbook` anchor in tickets.
oncall-bot: Reminder: add a "canary runbook" snippet to the release ticket and ping @sre 24h before the canary start.
morgan: Canary sizing and timing? some teams asked for standard guidance not just opinion.
sre: Recommended default: 5% for 2h (smoke), 20% for 8h (monitor), 50% hold 6h before full. For critical customer routes use 10% -> 25% -> hold 12h. Monitor synthetics, p95/p99, and error-rate.
chet: Rollback criteria (examples): error-rate increase >0.75% absolute, p99 latency >18% vs baseline, or synthetic check failures. If any trigger fires, engage the runbook and rollback unless mitigations are preapproved.
morgan: Notification matrix? who gets pinged at each stage?
sre: Pre-canary: @sre + @oncall 24h. Start: slack ping to release channel + direct mention of oncall. Ramp to 20%: notify product + support. Full ramp: notify sales/account owners. Immediate rollback: page @sre and post incident stub in #incidents.
acct-ops: For Dedicated customers we need a heads-up at least 48h and calendar alignment if there9s any chance of impacting throughput.
docs-team: I'll draft a 1-pager (internal checklist + customer blurb) and put it in the handbook. Volunteers to review?
riley: I can review the customer blurb. Also propose a 15m async retro template after each release; mandatory live follow-up only if rollback or customer impact.
cto-aaron: Agreed. Make the thresholds experimental for one quarter; track metrics and we9ll revisit. Good work everyone. I'll ask product to surface pre-release SLO badges on PRs so teams can see risk before merging.
chet: Example CLI we recommend for canaries:
```
rw-deploy release --svc inference-api --tag v4.2.0 --canary 5,20,50 --hold 6h --notify @sre --runbook-url <ticket-link>
```
chet: Thanks—once docs PR is up, tag #sales and #customer-success so they have the one-pager for renewals. :thumbsup:
